Duration shares at a timeframe

Source: R/navigate.R
calendar_share.Rd

Leaf shares summed to a timeframe and normalized — the time-side mirror of geoscales::geoscale_share(). Without within, shares sum to 1 over the whole calendar; with within (a coarser timeframe), they sum to 1 inside each parent label.

Usage

calendar_share(x, timeframe, within = NULL)

Arguments

x

A Calendar.

timeframe

Timeframe to aggregate the shares at.

within

Optional coarser timeframe to normalize within.

Value

A data.frame with the timeframe column (and the within column when given) plus share.

Examples

calendar_share(calendar("m12"), "MONTH")
#>    MONTH      share
#> 1    m01 0.08493151
#> 2    m02 0.07671233
#> 3    m03 0.08493151
#> 4    m04 0.08219178
#> 5    m05 0.08493151
#> 6    m06 0.08219178
#> 7    m07 0.08493151
#> 8    m08 0.08493151
#> 9    m09 0.08219178
#> 10   m10 0.08493151
#> 11   m11 0.08219178
#> 12   m12 0.08493151
calendar_share(calendar("q4_h24"), "HOUR", within = "QUARTER")
